description: Grid Heatmap Pro plots items such as risks on a configurable matrix, giving stakeholders an immediate view of the landscape. Items appear as markers inside color-coded cells, with an optional Legend field to group and distinguish items by category, owner, or status using different marker shapes and colors. The grid is fully customizable. Designed for risk managers, PMO leads, and project analysts who need a structured, repeatable way to communicate risk posture, whether for a project risk log, an enterprise risk register, or a portfolio-level rollup. Bind a Risk identifier, an X Axis field, and a Y Axis field to get started; all other fields are optional. Grid Heatmap Pro offers a free trial. Some advanced features require a paid license or subscription.
